posts.text: Namaste! 🙏 Kurtis sabse zyada bikti hain, par galat style ya size se stock atak jaata hai. Our new free guide shows how to pick kurti styles, fabrics, sizes and price levels that sell in your town. Padhiye aur apna next order smartly plan kijiye:

Kurtis are a year-round bestseller, but only if you stock the right ones. 👗

Our new guide for shop owners covers:
• Matching styles to the women who shop with you
• Cotton, rayon or festive fabrics by season
• Size ratios that avoid leftover XS and XXXL
• Testing at MOQ and reordering the winners

Read it free at the link in bio.

#WholesaleKurtis #KurtiWholesale #BoutiqueOwner #EthnicWear #RetailIndia #ClothingShop #GarmentBazaar

For clothing retailers in Tier 2, 3 and 4 towns, the kurti is often the most dependable seller on the shelf. It is also where buying mistakes quietly pile up: the wrong prints, equal quantities of every size, or a price level that does not fit the town.

We published a practical guide for shop owners on picking wholesale kurtis that sell: start from your real customer types, cover a few core cuts well, match fabrics to the season, order sizes from your own sales data, and test new styles at the brand's MOQ before reordering the winners.

If you run or advise a retail store outside the metros, we hope it is useful.
